lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\SSLTest\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

places: lib/BackgroundJob/StatusJob.php:40 OCA\SSLTest\Backgroundjob\StatusJob, by its path OCA\SSLTest\BackgroundJob\StatusJob
lines: 1 class in lib/ whose name does not follow PSR-4 below OCA\SSLTest, the namespace the server derives from <namespace> of info.xml. The loader of the server does not find such a class.
lib/BackgroundJob/StatusJob.php:40 OCA\SSLTest\Backgroundjob\StatusJob, by its path OCA\SSLTest\BackgroundJob\StatusJob
appinfo/info.xml names 1 class that appinfo/ and lib/ do not have. The server fails when it comes to load one.

1 timed job does not say whether it is time sensitive. A job that sets TIME_INSENSITIVE with setTimeSensitivity() is moved to the maintenance window of the server; whether a job is heavy enough for that only its maintainer knows.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 1 place. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.
